title: Malicious SHA-256 file hash d5d4249912af… (OffSeq Mirage)
description: A malicious file identified by the SHA-256 hash d5d4249912afc83472420ec77c8a97081800436df1e31d14bb814649e084e061 was observed by OffSeq Mirage honeypot sensors on 2026-10-24. This file was detected 9 times in attacker activity involving the T1105 technique (Ingress Tool Transfer), indicating it was used to stage or deliver a malicious payload such as a dropper, web shell, miner, or post-exploitation tool. The threat is an indicator of compromise (IOC) rather than a vulnerability or exploit itself. No known exploits or threat actors are associated with this hash, and no affected software versions or countries are specified.
